nodeAnnotations.rationale: Top-level container for the session info. Bounding box `272x173` defines the full card size.
Flex container holding the avatar and user details. Height is `64`. Contains flex-row layout of Avatar and User Info.
Image placeholder with overlapping status indicator dot. Width/Height `48x48`. The DOM shows a blue circle background for the avatar.
Column layout containing name, time, and status badge. Width `101.5625`, Height `64`.
Text element 'Amir Hosseini'. Height `18`. Corresponds to `learnerName` prop.
Text element 'Today, 4:00 PM'. Height `15`. Corresponds to `scheduledFor` prop.
Pill-shaped badge showing status. Height `23`. Corresponds to `status` prop. Text and Background Color vary by variant.
Row of text 'Score: 7/9'. Height `16`. Corresponds to the optional `score` prop.
Button element 'View details'. Height `35`. Corresponds to `Button` sub-component. Has a blue border.

notes: The Avatar component includes an indicator dot (span) at the bottom-right corner, likely indicating presence or online status. The Badge variant styles are significant: 'scheduled' uses amber/orange (`rgb(176, 106, 0)`), while 'missed' uses danger/red (`rgb(211, 57, 47)`). Both have white text and borders. The default 'completed' badge is green. (tool-call budget of 2 reached before the model signaled completion)

variantAxes.rationale: The source types define 'status' as a union of these three literal strings. Captures for each status are provided. The Badge component is the primary element exhibiting this variant.
